description: One election or survey in the connected account, as it is saved now: the schedule in its time zone, every question with its type, seats and options (in the words create_election_draft takes), the settings, the voter list as counts, ballots cast, turnout and quorum, and links. For a DRAFT election it also reports what still blocks publishing, what is worth checking, the exact price the publish step would charge, and who pays it (free, plan, prepaid balance, or card at the finish link). Per-question results are on the election page link; this tool reports counts only, never a voter's name, email or phone number.

election.description: The election's id or slug, from list_elections or create_election_draft.

name: get_election
title: Status of one election or survey
